svg.text: Amazon Quick → Microsoft Entra ID → Amazon CloudFront (custom domain) → Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway → Lambda target

g.text: App Roles: Tools.Mall.List / Footfall / Hourly / Zone (assigned per user)
v2 access token: aud = rsidc-mall-api app ID

g.data-name:
Amazon Quick MCP connector agentzone-mall-entra
Custom user based OAuth confidential client rsidc-quick-mcp-entra (client ID + secret) Base URL: https://mcp.agentzone.click/mcp
g.title:
Amazon Quick MCP connector agentzone-mall-entra
Custom user based OAuth confidential client rsidc-quick-mcp-entra (client ID + secret) Base URL: https://mcp.agentzone.click/mcp

g.text: Quick signs the user in to Entra ID (authorization code + client ID/secret), scope https://mcp.agentzone.click/mcp/mcp.access, resource = https://mcp.agentzone.click/mcp; Entra returns the user's v2 access token (roles).
Discovery: GET /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource is answered at the edge by CloudFront Function mcp-prm (resource = custom domain + scope).
MCP POST /mcp with Authorization: Bearer <Entra token>, via CloudFront (pass-through, CachingDisabled) to the Gateway.
Gateway validates the token signature with Entra JWKS (v2 discovery, allowedAudience = rsidc-mall-api app ID). No token exchange.
Policy in AgentCore (Cedar, ENFORCE) decides on the roles claim: allow / deny; tools/list is filtered per user.
Gateway invokes Lambda target "mall" with its IAM role (lambda:InvokeFunction); the result flows back to Quick.
Example per-user result: wei 4 tools · ds1 2 tools (hourly/zone denied) · chen 0
